name: CI

on:

jobs:

input.body:
## Summary

Recover original checkpoint `d7137aa` as one complete targeting/Healer batch, building on the landed actor parent and behavior work.

```text
registered mount Setup → independent target object
Run retry → Aim retry/rotation → enemy ally-count retarget → fire timer
Healer → source patient scan → exact health/range gate → retained beam
known missing-ally read → abort this Main.Run → next stage frame continues
```

Remove tank-wide target selection/resets. Retain current-wrapper array order, inclusive indices, direct object/parent lifetimes and previous-angle shots. Recover allied closest-detail prediction, Healer scan quirks, immediate beam removal and trigger/catch timer order. This is one coherent 22-file gameplay change; the original PR #1 remains preserved.

## Evidence

- **Before:** the previous master selector fails the independent-mount regression with `[0,0]` instead of `[90,0]`. The Healer missing-beam trigger regression also failed before its catch/timer correction.
  **After:** formatting, TypeScript, **680 tests / 7,134 assertions**, and production build pass.
- **Ten distinct native/mock browser cases pass**, without skips: mounted target/fire ordering, Healer frame-abort/recovery, actor behavior, both crossing populations and fresh-game boss/win pilots. The final targeting/Healer pair was rebuilt/rechecked in four passing cases (14.6s). Captures inspected. Pilots use the existing public upgrade-selection adapter; they are narrower than a human or synchronized original-runtime comparison.
- Decompiled Weapon, AllyGunAutoCannon, EBehaviorHealer, PredictTargetLocation and exported pcode audited. All 19 original checkpoint paths are accounted by this batch or the canonical parent/movement modules already landed. Source corrections replace the old checkpoint's active-only UID lookup, bounded Healer workaround and sticky prediction approximation.
- The scoped frame error boundary is supported by pinned reference AVM2 event/uncaught-error source and Main.Run registration; no new original-runtime/Adobe probe was executed. Unrelated host errors propagate. Broader null-objData/deactivation, exact camera/matrix precision, constructor/event RNG, later aim-flag/projectile work and full-game parity remain explicit in the fidelity ledger.
- No generated data, original media, dependencies or build output committed. Unsigned commit uses the user's existing authorization after 1Password failures. Vercel free-quota failures are explicitly waived; real Actions and review findings remain merge gates.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

Revert the single commit; no persisted schema migration.

**Blast Radius:** combat

Per-mount targets, source RNG consumption, aim/timer ordering, Healer patient/beam lifetime and scoped error-frame continuation.
